text:
RADIO (frontend, 45 min)

R  Requirements .......... 5 min
   features, devices, a11y, i18n, offline
A  Architecture .......... 10 min
   components, rendering, where state lives
D  Data model ............ 5 min
   server vs client state, cache shape
I  Interface (API) ........ 5 min
   server API + component props, events
O  Optimizations ........ 15 min
   speed, a11y, security, i18n, tests

Wrap-up .................. 5 min
